title: Swimcom Metric0 Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: Swim.com workouts (`swimcom:workout`), MySwimPro sessions (`myswimpro:session`), pool lap logs (`pool:lap`), and swim meet results (`swim:meet`).
app: Swim.com workout exports, MySwimPro session logs, pool lap counters, swim meet results, and interval pace trackers forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=swimcom:metric0 value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for swimcom metric0 data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for swimcom metric0 events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up the smoothed week-long trend in your value from swimcom metric0.
